title: Enhanced Due Diligence Committee and Second Review of Personal Sender Account Limit Reviews
content:
**Escalation of a limit review request on a Personal Sender Account.** The escalation step reads the recipients added to the account in the 12 months before the request date, an addition dated on the same calendar day 12 months earlier or before it no longer counting:

1. When 4 or more recipients were added, the request goes to the weekly enhanced due diligence committee, and the decision window is the counted decision window rounded up to the next whole multiple of 5 business days; a counted decision window that already is such a multiple stays as it is.
2. When at least 2 but fewer than 4 recipients were added, a second reviewer checks the file, and the decision window is the counted decision window plus half of it, that half rounded up to a whole business day.
3. When fewer than 2 recipients were added, the decision window is the counted decision window.

The counted decision window is the request's decision window in Paloma business days as counted before this step; the step acts on that whole figure once.

## Who reviews the file

| Recipients added in the 12 months | Reviewed by | Decision window |
|---|---|---|
| 4 or more | weekly enhanced due diligence committee | the counted decision window rounded up to a whole multiple of 5 |
| 2 or 3 | a second reviewer | the counted decision window plus half of it, the half rounded up |
| 0 or 1 | no escalation | the counted decision window |

## Worked figures (hypothetical counted decision windows)

| Counted decision window (business days) | Committee (4 or more recipients added) | Second reviewer (2 or 3 added) |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 5 | 3 plus 2, that is 5 |
| 6 | 10 | 6 plus 3, that is 9 |
| 7 | 10 | 7 plus 4, that is 11 |
| 10 | 10 (already a multiple of 5) | 10 plus 5, that is 15 |

Half of 7 is three and a half, rounded up to 4; half of 3 is one and a half, rounded up to 2.

## The records read

Each recipient added entry on the account history is one recipient added, counted by its date, whether or not the recipient is still saved or active today.
